lines.gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har charan ridai ur dhaare ||
lines.translation: I have enshrined the Lord's Feet within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਫਲ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: simar suaamee satigur apunaa kaaraj saphal hamaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Contemplating my Lord and Master, my True Guru, all my affairs have been resolved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pu(n)n daan poojaa paramesur har keerat tat beechaare ||
lines.translation: The merits of giving donations to charity and devotional worship come from the Kirtan of the Praises of the Transcendent Lord; this is the true essence of wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਤੁਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat atul sukh paaiaa thaakur agam apaare ||1||
lines.translation: Singing the Praises of the unapproachable, infinite Lord and Master, I have found immeasurable peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan paarabraham apane keene tin kaa baahur kachh na beechaare ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God does not consider the merits and demerits of those humble beings whom He makes His own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਠ ਮਝਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: naam ratan sun jap jap jeevaa har naanak ka(n)th majhaare ||2||11||30||
lines.translation: Hearing, chanting and meditating on the jewel of the Naam, I live; Nanak wears the Lord as his necklace. ||2||11||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: todee mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Todee, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਅਧਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahau kahaa apanee adhamaaee ||
lines.translation: What can I say about my base nature?

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿਓ ਕਨਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਕੇ ਰਸ ਨਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: urajhio kanak kaamanee ke ras nah keerat prabh gaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am entangled in the love of gold and women, and I have not sung the Kirtan of God's Praises. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਉਪਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag jhoothe kau saach jaan kai taa siu ruch upajaaee ||
lines.translation: I judge the false world to be true, and I have fallen in love with it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਹੋਤ ਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: deen ba(n)dh simario nahee kabahoo hot j sa(n)g sahaaee ||1||
lines.translation: I have never contemplated the friend of the poor, who shall be my companion and helper in the end. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਗਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨਿ ਛੁਟੀ ਨ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: magan rahio maaiaa mai nis din chhutee na man kee kaaee ||
lines.translation: I remain intoxicated by Maya, night and day, and the filth of my mind will not depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਬ ਨਾਹਿ ਅਨਤ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahi naanak ab naahi anat gat bin har kee saranaaee ||2||1||31||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, now, without the Lord's Sanctuary, I cannot find salvation in any other way. ||2||1||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: todee baanee bhagataa(n) kee ||
lines.translation: Todee, The Word Of The Devotees:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਿਰਵਾ ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee bolai niravaa koee bolai door ||
lines.translation: Some say that He is near, and others say that He is far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਚਰੈ ਖਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jal kee maachhulee charai khajoor ||1||
lines.translation: We might just as well say that the fish climbs out of the water, up the tree. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਇ ਰੇ ਬਕਬਾਦੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaa(n)i re bakabaad laaio ||
lines.translation: Why do you speak such nonsense?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਛਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har paaio tinahi chhapaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who has found the Lord, keeps quiet about it. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit hoi kai bed bakhaanai ||
lines.translation: Those who become Pandits, religious scholars, recite the Vedas,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: moorakh naamadeu raamahi jaanai ||2||1||
lines.translation: but foolish Naam Dayv knows only the Lord. ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਤ ਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun ko kala(n)k rahio raam naam let hee ||
lines.translation: Whose blemishes remain, when one chants the Lord's Name?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਭਏ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit pavit bhae raam kahat hee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Sinners become pure, chanting the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਗਿਆ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam sa(n)g naamadev jan kau pratagiaa aaee ||
lines.translation: With the Lord, servant Naam Dayv has come to have faith.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਈਁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ekaadasee brat rahai kaahe kau teerath jaaee(n) ||1||
lines.translation: I have stopped fasting on the eleventh day of each month; why should I bother to go on pilgrimages to sacred shrines? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਭਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhanat naamadeu sukrit sumat bhae ||
lines.translation: Prays Naam Dayv, I have become a man of good deeds and good thoughts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਗਏ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramat raam kahi ko ko na baiku(n)th gae ||2||2||
lines.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instructions, who has not gone to heaven? ||2||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਛੰਦੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਛੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teen chha(n)de khel aachhai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Here is a verse with a three-fold play on words. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਭਾਰ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਸਾਂਡੀ ਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: ku(n)bhaar ke ghar haa(n)dee aachhai raajaa ke ghar saa(n)dee go ||
lines.translation: In the potter's home there are pots, and in the king's home there are camels.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਮਨ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਰਾਂਡੀ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਂਡੀ ਸਾਂਡੀ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਗੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: baaman ke ghar raa(n)dee aachhai raa(n)dee saa(n)dee haa(n)dee go ||1||
lines.translation: In the Brahmin's home there are widows. So here they are: haandee, saandee, raandee. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀਏ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹੀਂਗੁ ਆਛੈ ਭੈਸਰ ਮਾਥੈ ਸੀਂਗੁ ਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: baaneee ke ghar hee(n)g aachhai bhaisar maathai see(n)g go ||
lines.translation: In the home of the grocer there is asafoetida; on the forehead of the buffalo there are horns.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਲ ਮਧੇ ਲੀਗੁ ਆਛੈ ਲੀਗੁ ਸੀਗੁ ਹੀਗੁ ਗੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: deval madhe leeg aachhai leeg seeg heeg go ||2||
lines.translation: In the temple of Shiva there are lingams. So here they are: heeng, seeng, leeng. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਲੀ ਕੈ ਘਰ ਤੇਲੁ ਆਛੈ ਜੰਗਲ ਮਧੇ ਬੇਲ ਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: telee kai ghar tel aachhai ja(n)gal madhe bel go ||
lines.translation: In the house of the oil-presser there is oil; in the forest there are vines.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਕੇਲ ਆਛੈ ਕੇਲ ਬੇਲ ਤੇਲ ਗੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maalee ke ghar kel aachhai kel bel tel go ||3||
lines.translation: In the gardener's home there are bananas. So here they are: tayl, bayl, kayl. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਮਧੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਆਛੈ ਗੋਕਲ ਮਧੇ ਸਿਆਮ ਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa(n) madhe gobi(n)d aachhai gokal madhe siaam go ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe, Govind, is within His Saints; Krishna, Shyaam, is in Gokal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਮਧੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਆਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naame madhe raam aachhai raam siaam gobi(n)d go ||4||3||
lines.translation: The Lord, Raam, is in Naam Dayv. So here they are: Raam, Shyaam, Govind. ||4||3||
